action.text: The committee report referred to in this resolution is H.Rept. 119-831.
The committee favorably reported H.Rept. 119-831 by the yeas and nays 41-0.
Mr. Comer asked unanimous consent to call up H. Res. 1543 and asked for its immediate consideration.

vote.text: On agreeing to the resolution Agreed to without objection.

action.text: Motion to reconsider laid on the table Agreed to without objection.
